notes: Search budget (WebSearch, Tavily, Lune, scite) was exhausted during this run, so sources were limited to pages reachable directly (TUV SUD, ISO 16750-4 iTeh preview, Infineon KBA, batterydesign.net, PMC, MDPI) plus Consensus abstracts whose DOIs were confirmed via Crossref. Quotes for Liu 2022 (SAE), Hu 2021 (IJHE) and Wan 2025 (IJR) are verbatim publisher abstracts as indexed by Consensus; the publisher pages were captcha-blocked and not opened. UN 38.3 and AEC-Q100 values come from a test-lab page (TUV SUD) and a manufacturer KBA (Infineon) because unece.org and aecouncil.com could not be fetched; AEC-Q100 temperature-cycling (TC) conditions were not retrievable, so that profile is the Grade 0 operating-range check only. IEC 62660-1 is from the batterydesign.net summary (secondary source). ISO 16750-4 code C (Tmin -40 C, Tmax 65 C) was chosen for the cycling profile; its sweep-rate requirement is arithmetic on the quoted profile and is non-mandatory. In Herran 2026 the Binder KB53 is named for the pre-opening 25 C discharge; the retrieved text does not name the chamber used for -10 C aging. Most automotive procedures are climatic-chamber tests whose deciding keys are temperature.range and electrical.sample_connections; no size gate is stated in the sources except the 500 L tank. The existing automotive profiles (20 K membrane permeation, 304L tensile at 20 K, LH2 composite fatigue) are not duplicated.
